alpha_selection.rule: lowest mean time-CV MAE inside train; family and popularity variant not reopened

criterion: PASS if test MAE of Ridge is at least 10% below the test MAE of B1, else FAIL

final_fit.refit: Ridge pipeline, B2 mean and B3 linear fit on train + validation; B1 needs no fit

planned_sensitivity.largest_errors: the 10 largest Ridge errors: id, romaji title, season, ep3, prediction, label
planned_sensitivity.secondary_label: same predictions scored against the finale + 5..9 label, shows that have one, Ridge and B1

preprocessing: genres: multi-hot, vocabulary from the fitting rows, unseen genres ignored
log1p for popularity and in-progress counts
all fitted on train + validation rows only

run_once: reports/model_a_v1.json is written once; a rerun needs --rerun-reason and is stored in the report
